text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The Yasuda Kinen is almost here! Oguri's definitely gonna be hard to beat. I've got to keep training till the last second if I want to stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I've got to make sure to thank Oguri! If it wasn't for her, I would never have been able to get so fired up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, I get it now! That's what Oguri means to me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Yasuda Kinen and Oguri's in great shape! She even went out of her way to talk to me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaah! I'm really burning hot now! I'm not gonna lose! I'll use this race to show Yaeno what Oguri really is!
